purpose: Offline R10 bounded auxiliary core split and targeted services diagnostic
broad_transformation: Select only SCPICLEM02YOYPECNA and SCPICLEM03YOYPECNA from the source CSV; discard outer months where both are absent; require both finite in every retained month; rename to goods/services. No index rebasing, percent conversion, interpolation, seasonal adjustment or tax adjustment.
level_transformation: Copied the audit canonical 2015=100 five-group monthly levels unchanged; source audit verified all 695 observations against the full raw official file. raw/raw_cen0101e_selected.csv contains boundary excerpts, while raw/selected_category_levels.csv holds the read-only level extract; the complete 65 MB original file is represented by its source URL and SHA256 in audit/manifest.json.
weight_transformation: Copied all 35 long-form canonical base basket weights unchanged. Old holiday code 09.6 (through 2024) maps to current 098; 2026 basket 09.8. No normalisation or price updating.
archive_note: audit/ files retain original source-audit conclusions. The 09:00 recommendation in archived FINDINGS/canonical metadata is superseded for this approved experiment by the existing midnight date convention documented in the top-level canonical_metadata.json.
portable_note: Absolute paths in archived extracts identify the source session only. load_frozen reads only the relative frozen manifest paths and needs no database or network.
